::The envoy is somehow able to maintain his calm - but only barely - in spite of the fact that you forced his whole escort to a premature leave. Still, the signs of anxiety are as visible as train lights coming out of the black: His eyes are dilated and locked onto yours, his face is red, his throat is dry and his lower lip twitches more and more with every passing second. He is the first to break the silence.::
What do you want from me...? Money? If, if that's what you want, I'll give you all I have in exchange for my life. Ninety dollars, that is all I have. It's all yours if you want it!<end>
